create_RadianceFieldRenderer: create a RadianceFieldRenderer with coarse and fine NeRF rendering passes for a given image size and depth range
run_forward_RadianceFieldRenderer: run the forward pass of RadianceFieldRenderer to render coarse and fine RGB images from a camera viewpoint
precache_rays_RadianceFieldRenderer: precache rays for a list of cameras to speed up repeated rendering from the same viewpoints
process_ray_chunk_RadianceFieldRenderer: process a single chunk of rays through the coarse and fine rendering passes and return RGB outputs
visualize_nerf_outputs: visualize NeRF rendering outputs including coarse, fine, and ground truth images along with 3D camera ray plots in Visdom
